👋 Quick reminder before you dive in

  1. Everything's open except Hours, so you can see the whole form at a glance. Each section has a Continue button at the bottom if you'd rather go one at a time, it closes the current section and opens the next. Jump around anytime using the menu on the left, or the Expand/Collapse all buttons above it.
  2. Your answers save automatically right in this browser, nothing is sent anywhere until you choose to send it. Close the tab any time and reopen this same file later to pick up where you left off.
  3. Everything here is optional, skip anything that doesn't apply to Miramar. Use the "Not applicable" or "Not sure, someone else knows" buttons at the top of any section instead of leaving it blank and wondering later.
  4. When you're ready to send us what you have, scroll to the very bottom and click "Copy & Open Email." It copies your answers and opens your email app in one step, ready for you to paste (⌘V / Ctrl+V) and send.
Tip: this is one single file, you can save it anywhere (Desktop, Downloads, email it to a co-worker) and your progress travels with it as long as you reopen it in the same browser on the same computer. Use the "Download Backup" button at the bottom to keep a portable copy of your answers too.
